newsitem.title: USA: Transaction, American unit in deal.
newsitem.headline: Transaction, American unit in deal.

text.p: Transaction Network Services Inc said on Wednesday it signed a multi-year agreement with American Express Travel Related Services Company Inc.

Stipulated in the agreement are measures to provide transaction transport services directly to one of the largest credit card issuers and processors. Effective January 1, the contract is worth over $6 million.
American Express Travel Related Services Company Inc is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the American Express Company, a diversified worldwide travel and financial services company founded in 1850.
Transaction Network provides data communications services for transaction-oriented applications.
